servers.title: Choose your server
servers.looking: Looking for Pley on your network…
servers.noneFound: No servers found. Make sure this TV and the server are on the same network, or enter the server's address.
servers.forgetHint: Press * on a saved server to forget it.
servers.forgetBody: Pley signs this TV out of it and deletes what it saved from it.

address.title: Enter your server's address
address.hint: Such as 192.168.1.20, nas or pley.example.com. Port 7539 is used by default.

link.title: Sign in to Pley
link.ended: The server ended this TV's sign-in: sign in again.
link.widerScope: The server allowed more than Pley for Roku asks for, so it was signed out.
link.requests: Sign in again to let this TV ask for movies and shows.
link.approvals: Sign in again to approve and decline requests here.
link.goTo: On your phone or computer, go to
link.sameNetwork: Your phone must be on this TV's network, or able to reach the server's address.
link.renewed: That code expired, so here is a new one. Waiting for approval…
link.retrying: Can't reach the server. Trying again in {{seconds}} s.
link.expired: Code expired: press OK for a new one.
link.twoStep: This server requires two-step sign-in: your phone sets it up if you haven't yet.

profiles.title: Who's watching?
profiles.cantSwitchSignIn: This sign-in can't switch profiles: sign in again, and choose the profile in the browser.
profiles.unusable: This profile can't be used from the app.
profiles.needsPassword: This profile needs its password: sign in to it with a code, and choose it in the browser.

unreachable.title: Can't reach {{name}}
unreachable.body: Pley for Roku can't reach the server at {{address}}. Check that it's on, and that this TV is on the same network as the server.

problems.tooOld: This server is too old for this app: update it.
problems.noCodes: This server can't sign in with a code yet: update it.
problems.callsItself: This server calls itself {{address}}: open it by that address, or check that the proxy in front of it passes Host.
problems.signInElsewhere: This server sends apps to another address to sign in: Pley doesn't.
problems.unreadable: The server's answer can't be read: try again.
problems.throttled: Too many wrong PINs: try again in a few minutes.
problems.pinLocked: This profile's PIN is locked after too many wrong tries. Its owner or an administrator can reset it.
problems.browser: This profile needs its password: sign in to it with a code, choosing it in the browser.
problems.notAllowed: You can't switch to this profile.
problems.ticketSpent: This cast's switch expired: cast again.
problems.codeUsed: This code doesn't work any more: get a new one.
problems.unknownApp: This server doesn't know Pley for Roku yet: update it.
problems.unauthorizedClient: This server doesn't let Pley for Roku sign in with a code.
problems.invalidScope: This server doesn't offer what Pley for Roku asks for: update it.
problems.busy: Too many sign-ins are waiting on this server: try again in a few minutes.
problems.profileChanged: Another profile is signed in now.
problems.badAddress: Enter an address such as nas, 192.168.1.20 or pley.example.com.
problems.notSetUp: This server isn't set up yet: open {{address}} in a browser first.
problems.unencryptedAddress: {{address}} isn't on your network and isn't encrypted: open it by its https address.
problems.notPley: Something answers at {{address}}, but it isn't Pley.
problems.unreachableAddress: Couldn't reach {{address}}. Check the address, and that the server is on.
problems.unencrypted: This server isn't on your network and isn't encrypted: open it by its https address to sign in.
problems.widerScope: The server allowed more than Pley for Roku asks for, so it was signed out again.
